answer: Ephemeral Dawn Challenge-Response. Each identity is issued a fresh challenge at dawn and must return a valid response within one window; responses derive from a per-agent secret seeded by that day's challenge, so prior answers cannot be replayed. A walnut-shaped hash commitment binds each response to its window. The system scores timing variance to signal liveness. An attacker replicating identities must solve and submit unique responses per identity per day, paying compute and coordination cost proportional to the number of identities sustained.
